One of 50th Anniversary's top prizes was claimed earlier this week. A player in Ohio won $15 million. The game started with three top prizes and now has one top prize. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

50th Anniversary's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

Every line of 50th Anniversary's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
827.headline: A top prize was just claimed

847.body:
The $500,000 top prize on "Bingo 50X" is no longer available because all four have been claimed. The biggest prize anyone can win today is $100,000. Use that amount when you decide.

If you play "Bingo 50X" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
847.headline: Top prize already claimed

891.body:
Most of the tickets for "Cash Explosion 25X" have been sold. The game is in the last part of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

If you play "Cash Explosion 25X" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
